title: Emission factors

description.suffix: IPCC 2006 / AR5 and IEA 2024 — versioned and region-tagged. The preferred row for each factor is ranked for your market.
description.prefixCn: MEE / NBS China grid factors, GB/T fuel defaults, DEFRA 2024, EPA 2024,

actions.importSoon: Bulk import is coming soon. Add factors one at a time for now.

search.placeholder: Search name, category, source, region or unit…

loadError.title: Couldn't load emission factors
loadError.body: No factors are shown rather than an incomplete list. Try again; if this persists, ask an admin to run setup to seed the table.

empty.title: No factors match
empty.body: Try a different search, or clear the filters.
empty.preferredBody: No preferred factors match. Turn off “Preferred only” to see every version.

ipcc.name: IPCC 2006 Guidelines
ipcc.desc: Default factors for stationary and mobile combustion. Tier 1 methodology.

defra.name: DEFRA 2024
defra.desc: UK Government conversion factors for GHG reporting. Updated annually.

iea.name: IEA 2024
iea.desc: International Energy Agency country grid factors. Used where no official national source exists.

references.title: Publishers
references.subtitle: Where the library's factors come from.
references.subtitleCn: For mainland sites, official China sources are preferred over IEA.

mee.name: MEE / NBS (China)
mee.desc: Ministry of Ecology and Environment and National Bureau of Statistics grid factors: national average, market-based residual, fossil-only and seven regional grids. CO₂ only.

gbt.name: GB/T 32150-2015
gbt.desc: China's industrial GHG accounting standard — default fuel parameters (NCV × carbon content × oxidation).

confirmDelete: Historical activity data that references this factor is kept; it will no longer appear in the library.

modal.title: Add emission factor
modal.description: The new factor joins its activity group; the preferred row is re-ranked for your market.

vendor.title: Find by vendor (AI)
vendor.hint: Type a supplier name and the AI picks the closest factor from your library.
vendor.placeholder: e.g. United Airlines, Office Depot, AWS
vendor.orgDisabled: AI features are turned off for your organisation. An admin can turn them on in Settings.
vendor.notConfigured: AI factor matching isn't connected in this workspace. An admin can connect an AI provider in Settings → Integrations.

emptyLibrary.title: The library is empty
emptyLibrary.body: Run setup to seed the standard factor packs, or add your first factor.
